units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 3:4">Targ. Am. III, 4</cite> <he>מַרְבּוּעִיתֵיה</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <he>מַרְבּוּעָ׳</he>). Targ. II Esth. I, 2 <cite ref="M02508"><he>מַרְבְּעוּ׳</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 73a:9">B. Bath. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>בי מַרְבַּעְתֵּיה דכוכבא זוטא</he> the resting place of a small star (Ms. F. <he>בי מַעְבַּרְתֵּיה</he> the transit of &c.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 73b:2">Ib.ᵇ</cite> <he>בי מ׳ דרישיה</he> the place where his head rests.
